clock: UTC epoch milliseconds; aware UTC presentation
entry: First complete hourly bar opening at/after max(cutoff, completion, registration, data availability); confirmation close precedes next-open fill; fresh revalidation mandatory

costs.funding: actual settlement events only; missing coverage invalidates settlement; historical mark proxy must be disclosed
costs.fill: D ledger next open adverse slippage; stop-first if both touched; no leverage/liquidation validation

metrics.win_rate: positive settled simulated trades / all settled simulated trades
metrics.coverage: observed / eligible; failures, WAIT and invalid plans separate
metrics.direction_accuracy: disabled without separately frozen target/horizon/truth definition

limitations: No F2 observations or F3 settlement in F1
No optional missing/stale evidence directional inference
No automatic Memory or Reflection learning
Local hashes detect accidental modification, not malicious rewriting of all files
Historical and late imports excluded from prospective performance
Pair by exchange instrument cutoff and timeframe set; reports are not independent market samples
